name: Saregama India Ltd
title: Saregama India Ltd - 532163 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Music-catalogue company, not a capacity business: Q4 revenue INR 287 cr (+19% YoY) and record adjusted EBITDA INR 133 cr, but management concedes content spend is ramping and FY27 content budget INR 300-350 cr with no step-up after.

triggers.label: New content spend FY27 INR 300-350 cr
triggers.quote: our new content budget to be anything between INR 300-350 crores this year
triggers.highlight: new content budget to be anything between INR 300-350 crores

triggers.label: Airtel Wynk platform shut; free-platform headwind over
Music vertical 20-23% revenue CAGR held
triggers.quote: we continue with our medium-term guidance of 20-23% CAGR in terms of revenue

triggers.label: H2 music growth 26% vs H1 8%
triggers.quote: H1 has seen a growth of 8%, while H2 has seen a growth of 26%
triggers.highlight: H2 has seen a growth of 26%

guidance.quote: we continue with our medium-term guidance of 20-23% CAGR in terms of revenue
our annual EBITDA guidance for this vertical being anything between 60-65%
our new content budget to be anything between INR 300-350 crores this year
over the next 3-5 years, you should have 300-500 bps increase coming on our music business
We expect this IP to break even by FY28.

prior_guidance_check.quote: As promised, Pocket Aces has reached breakeven this year.
Our spend of INR 235 crores on new content was lower than what we had planned

red_flags.label: Unallocable expense ~10x rise FY23-FY26 explained as netting-off, not fully reconciled
red_flags.quote: I think I need to take this offline because between FY23 and FY26 other income has dropped only INR 10 crores

red_flags.label: Provision write-back in cost line; management asks to judge on rolling 12-month basis
red_flags.quote: It's all sitting part on cost structure only.

red_flags.label: Management repeatedly deflects quarterly and competitor questions
red_flags.quote: Please don't look at from the quarter perspective

evasions.topic: Subscription revenue share and growth split
evasions.quote: No, no. So let me not go back and share that data. It's just too competitor sensitive data.
So, unfortunately, I don't have a CFO at this moment.
I can talk only about myself.
